entries.description: Directed E5 to begin: countersigned the slots and said start phase 18.

Refused to count EventuallyAtMost as a matrix cell. No error existed — the predicate is real work. But E5's abandonment criterion is denominated in CELLS, so counting the tool as the result would corrupt the one number the pre-registration judges. The pre-registered bar is what made this visible.
First tail-merge attempt used N1 + abs N2 + abs N1 and four lemmas that do not exist in MachLib; the file's own idiom is max N1 N2. Caught by the build, not by a gate.

findings.description: EventuallyAtMost + log_le shipped: the dual predicate Phase 17 named as the AboveOne column's obstruction. Matrix unchanged at 11/25 — this is the predicate, not a cell.
